claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not prove quality or condition beyond visible wear.

risks.risk: What the drum is for / what it previously contained (food-grade vs chemical vs unknown), which affects safety and usability in Lagos.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any label/sticker on the drum (front/back/sides) showing contents/grade, plus a photo of the inside (open lid) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown/possibly non-food-use drum (worst case for buyer safety).

risks.risk: Capacity/size (e.g., 50L/100L/200L) cannot be confirmed from the photos, which drives the market price.
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape/ruler across the drum diameter and height, or the exact volume marking on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the smallest common size for this type of drum until size is proven.

risks.risk: Seal integrity and lid condition (leaks, warped lid, damaged gasket) cannot be confirmed from exterior photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lid seal/gasket area and a short video showing the lid closing properly; ideally a leak test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed leak-proof (worst case).

risks.risk: Whether the drum is clean/odor-free (residue from previous contents).
risks.proof: Photo of the inside after opening (and a quick smell/odor confirmation by seller in video).

proof_requests: Clear photos of any labels/markings on the drum (front/back/sides) showing contents/grade and capacity.
A photo of the inside after opening the lid (and close-up of the seal/gasket).
A measuring tape photo (diameter and height) to confirm volume.
A short video showing the lid closing and the drum being handled (to confirm no cracks/warping).
response.reason: The photos show a blue plastic drum with a lidded top, but key pricing drivers (size/capacity, contents/grade, and seal/cleanliness) are not verifiable from the images provided.
